recommendation: Keep the source fix. If the work group wants an explicit unknown or other concept instead of optional status, handle that as a new terminology/cardinality decision because it would differ from the applied FHIR-55268 resolution.
issue_request: FHIR-55268 was Applied with resolution Persuasive with Modification. It requested an escape valve because NutritionProduct.status was mandatory, had a required binding, and the value set had no unknown or other concept. The accepted resolution was to change the status cardinality to 0..1.
initial_application: The Jira-applied commit 3b2d08c1b61cc0418e57e120f851ed6ab991c8d3 changed NutritionProduct.status from min=1 to min=0 in source/nutritionproduct/structuredefinition-NutritionProduct.xml, and the current branch already contained that change.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists nutritionproduct=NutritionProduct, so the edited StructureDefinition is in build scope. The current Nutrition Product Status code system still defines only active, inactive, and entered-in-error. OO Nutrition minutes for 2026-02-25 reference FHIR-55268 without adding conflicting instructions, and targeted Zulip/Confluence searches found no direct contrary discussion. A later same-day NutritionProduct source reorder under FHIR-53526 touched the same file but did not change the current FHIR-55268 cardinality outcome.
reconciliation: Changed the NutritionProduct.status comment from stale unknown-code guidance to 'If populated, one of the defined statuses must apply.' This preserves the applied 0..1 cardinality and required binding while removing an instruction to use a code that is not in the value set.
source_changes: source/nutritionproduct/structuredefinition-NutritionProduct.xml: replaced stale NutritionProduct.status comment text that referenced a non-existent unknown status code.

related_jiras.note: Same-day NutritionProduct source reorder touched the same StructureDefinition after the FHIR-55268 commit; current source still retained FHIR-55268's optional cardinality, so it was not decided here.
